title: Remix - a platform for ai game devs
author: brizzle82
selftext:
Hey aigamedev! I work at Remix and realized it's silly that I've never posted in this community. 

Remix is a platform to make and share games that target web. We have a website where you can create or upload your own games [remix.gg](https://remix.gg)

We also have an [iOS mobile app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/remix-tiktok-for-games/id6748889050) where users come to play the games you've uploaded.

comments.body:
this is really cool, gonna give it a try! been playing with things like rosebud.ai. 

I'm also trying to make a 'ai vibe-coder' discord server for AI game devs and vibe-coders, people to hang out, chat, and share ideas without all the "AI slop" or "learn how to do actually do it" criticisms y'know? will have to link this in there and keep it in mind

comments.author: Fratini
comments.body: So cool. Curious to know the tech stack used to build the platform.

replies.author: brizzle82
replies.body: Since we enforce html as the build target, there’s no crazy part to the stack. Just serving up user defined games.

replies.author: Fratini
replies.body: Thanks for your reply OP. I'm currently experimenting building a small game for Remix.gg. One more follow-up question if you don't mind. Is your iOS shell mostly SwiftUI + WKWebView for gameplay, or do you still lean on UIKit for performance?

replies.author: brizzle82
replies.body: Games are presented in a WebView to keep things compatible with our miniapps for Telegram, Base, World, and Farcaster.
